title: Ancestor Line Brick-Wall Heatmap
dataSources: Hints (`genealogy:hint`), cemetery visits (`genealogy:cemetery`), family-photo work (`genealogy:photo`), research ops (`genealogy:ops`).
app: Genealogy and family-history telemetry — Ancestry hints, cemetery visit logs, and photo-restoration queues — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=genealogy:ops ancestor_line=* brick_wall="yes"
| stats count as brick_wall_cases by ancestor_line
| sort - brick_wall_cases
description: Ranks ancestor line by brick-wall cases volume for stalled family lines.
value: Volume rankings show which ancestor line are producing the most activity, demand, or friction inside stalled family lines.
implementation: Capture each brick-wall cases as a `genealogy:ops` event and normalize `ancestor_line` so the totals are comparable.
visualization: Bar chart of brick-wall cases volume by ancestor line.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers which ancestor line show up the most in stalled family lines so you know where the busiest areas are.
